pages.text: Life energy is polymerized from akaishi energy by the Life Conversion Matrix (10M energy → 10 life energy per conversion, 45 conversions per tick).$(br)Life Energy Solid is the cornerstone material of life research — to play with life, first you must "forge" it.

The Life Energy Cell and Life Energy Pipes handle storage and transport of life energy.$(br)Sample collection, organ construction... every life-research device runs on it. With energy in place, you can work wonders.
